name: aether
description: Adaptive Event-driven Trusted Human-Environment for Real-time collaboration
author: Your Name

scripts.build: corepack pnpm --dir packages/shared-types run build && corepack pnpm --dir apps/api run build && corepack pnpm --dir apps/web run build
scripts.test: corepack pnpm --dir apps/api run test && corepack pnpm --dir apps/web run test
scripts.test:ci: corepack pnpm --dir apps/api exec jest --testPathIgnorePatterns=integration --testPathIgnorePatterns=upload --passWithNoTests && corepack pnpm --dir apps/web exec jest --passWithNoTests
scripts.test:all: corepack pnpm test && corepack pnpm test:integration && corepack pnpm test:e2e
scripts.lint: corepack pnpm --dir apps/api exec eslint src --ext .ts && corepack pnpm --dir apps/web exec next lint
scripts.typecheck: corepack pnpm --dir packages/shared-types exec tsc --noEmit && corepack pnpm exec tsc --noEmit -p apps/api/tsconfig.json && corepack pnpm --dir apps/web exec next typegen . && corepack pnpm exec tsc --noEmit --incremental false -p apps/web/tsconfig.json
